Bound and gagged by crystal: 3d6 damage, then 1d6 per round. Only mental actions; manifesting needs a concentration check (DC 20 + half the continuous damage). Break free with DC 20 Strength or Escape Artist (1 round). The crystal has AC 5, hardness 12, 30 hp.
